findings.title: Digital video will be the top priority format in 2026
findings.excerpt: 87% of media experts cite digital video as a top priority over display and audio

findings.title: Ad adjacency to AI-generated content is a major upcoming challenge
findings.excerpt: 56% of media experts cite ad adjacency to content generated by AI as a top media challenge in the coming year

findings.title: Attention measurement viewed as critical success factor for retail media networks
findings.excerpt: 84% of media experts agree measuring attention is an important metric to evaluate campaign performance

findings.title: Brand-safety concerns are growing in CTV environments
findings.excerpt: 82% of media experts agree brand safety in CTV environments will be a growing concern as the volume of CTV inventory and the number of CTV sellers increase

findings.title: Influencer/creator suitability is key for digital video ads
findings.excerpt: 89% of media experts think brand safety and suitability of the influencer/creator will be an important consideration when advertising adjacent to digital video content
